name: Nam Et-Phou Louey National Protected Area
story: Nam Et-Phou Louey National Park is a protected area in northern Laos, covering 4,107.1 km2 across Houaphan, Luang Prabang, and Xieng Khouang. It consists mainly of mountains and hills with a tropical monsoon climate.
matters: The area has a high level of biodiversity, sheltering endangered species such as the dhole and the sambar deer within its forests and river habitats.
